documents.title: Bambu Support for PA/PET Technical Data Sheet V1.0
Bambu Support for PA/PET Safety Data Sheet SDS20250723S03
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: No hex: the store page links no hex-code document for this filament and none is cached, so its only colour value "Green (65500)" has no published hex.

not_published: the TDS states "N/A" for glass transition, Vicat softening, heat deflection (1.8 and 0.45 MPa) and every mechanical row (X-Y and Z) and says the mechanical properties "are not supplied here"; the store page tables repeat "N / A". Filament length and hardness are stated nowhere.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: melt index 29.2 ± 2.1 g/10 min (280 °C, 2.16 kg), saturated water absorption rate 1.23 % (25 °C, 55% RH), crystallization temperature N/A, spool material PC + ABS (temperature resistance 90 °C), spool size 200 × 67 mm, printing and storage humidity < 20% RH (sealed, with desiccant), retraction length 0.8 - 1.4 mm, retraction speed 20 - 40 mm/s, odor, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products. The bed surface preparation row (PVP Glue) is kept as the requires → PVP Glue relation.

The TDS recommended chamber temperature (p.2, "Chamber Temperature 45 - 60 °C") is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (registry type number, template field chamber_temp_max), not a filament's recommended range, as in the other filament files.
motion.max_flow is neither curated nor marked not_published: it is a printer / hotend key, as in the other filament files, and no cached document gives a volumetric flow for this filament.

Adjudication against the second extraction (71 field disagreements), every disputed fact re-read in the cached TDS, SDS, the three wiki pages and the store page. Same fact, this file's form kept: locator wording (TDS section paths, wiki row and column paths, What's in the Box lines), the AMS, A1 Series, plate and filament target handles (each in the reviewed compat-targets.json or the manifest), and the enclosed-printer target ("Enclosed printer", kind family: a class of printers, as in the other filament files). material.net_weight is written as 0.5 kg, the TDS's own figure. material.spool_type is the store bullet "Comes with High Temperature Reusable Spool" (unverified), not the TDS row "Spool Material PC + ABS (Temperature resistance 90 °C)", which gives the spool's material, not its type. The PVP glue relation is added from the TDS Bed Surface Preparation row as requires, as in the other filament files (the second extraction wrote recommended_with). extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters is taken from the second extraction (0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm; the material-table wiki nozzle table, quoted with its header cells), as the sibling Support for ABS, PA6-CF and PET-CF files write it. Not added: thermal.chamber_temp (see above), the motion.max_flow not_published entry (see above), and a separate "PA-GF" relation: the store bullet's "PA-GF" is the PA6-GF of the same page's Parameters Comparison row (no PA-GF product or compat label exists) and is quoted in the PA6-GF relation note. The nozzle-size, plate and hardened-steel relations the second extraction lacked are stated by the store page's Parameters Comparison table and the TDS p.1 and are kept. The 0.2 mm relation label is now "0.2 mm Nozzle" (the wiki column header and the reviewed-unresolvable label), and the P1P note follows the reviewed compat-targets.json (no target).
SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: model "S03-xx", CLP "Not classified", and "Not hazardous goods" for sea, road and air transport.
The store page says "Bambu Support for PA/PET has been discontinued." and names Bambu ABS and Bambu ASA as alternatives for PA/PET support.
The store page links a "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/bf35c3ce0472420599ad3703e7b71e8a.pdf) that was not cached; safety.certifications is left to review.
